title: A graph neural network-based interpretable framework reveals a novel DNA fragility-associated chromatin structural unit
summary: A GNN and GNNExplainer applied to Hi-C maps identify a DNA-fragility-associated chromatin interaction network and relate its neck interactions to double-strand breaks; this is a specific biological result.
